stimulus.sampling: uniform over every id, with replacement, no exclusions

definitions.previous_token: mean over sequences and AA positions j = 1..199 of the attention j -> j-1
definitions.induction: mean over sequences and second-half positions j = 100..199 of the attention j -> j-99
definitions.duplicate: mean over sequences and second-half positions j = 100..199 of the attention j -> j-100
definitions.copy: mean over sequences and positions j = 100..198 of <z_j W_O, W_U[:, x_(j+1)]>; no b_O, no final LayerNorm
definitions.copy_abs: |copy|, the gated ranking: wang-2022 Fig. 17 orders heads by absolute contribution

weights.loaded_by: src/lesion/model.py::load_model (TransformerLens from_pretrained defaults: LayerNorm folded, writing weights and unembedding centred)
